patterns: Trailer day = frame-by-frame day: 26 Avengers: Doomsday posts drew about 50% of all hit views. DiscussingFilm split the final trailer into single-beat posts (Cyclops line, Thor's Odinforce, Cap vs Cyclops, Steve's son, Kate Bishop, Doom), and each one cleared 370K–22M on its own.

The quoted line beat the trailer link: DiscussingFilm's Cyclops 'To me, my X-Men!' post did 22,231,496 views vs 14,974,031 for its 'new trailer released' post (1.5x). A second quote post ('There were 6 of us...') still did 603,036.

Film references inside games travel: 4 GTA 6 easter-egg posts tied to film or other franchises (Vice City 13,247,137; Mario 4,966,553; Pennywise 1,017,565; Saw 859,723) plus the PS launch record made up about 22% of hit views.

Candid insider anecdotes: Charlie Cox told he was 'too old' for Bond (1,640,035), Fincher on Netflix wanting Mindhunter more like CSI (1,278,012), Anya Taylor-Joy starstruck by McKellen as Gandalf (431,981).
Casting posts with a big director attached and a named source: Sanada in Cretton's Naruto (1,527,591), Spielberg's The Heart in Winter cast (1,429,858), Deborah Ann Woll in God of War (977,865).
Theater-experience news gets a share: the Super Bowl in IMAX for the first time (1,190,023) and a black & white Godzilla Minus Zero re-release (426,968).
narrative_synthesis: Avengers: Doomsday's final trailer (Dec 18) took the day: 26 posts and about half of all hit views, led by DiscussingFilm's Cyclops 'To me, my X-Men!' line at 22.2M. GTA 6 easter eggs with film references were the second-biggest wave. Spielberg's new cast, Sanada in Naruto, Ted Lasso S5 and the Super Bowl in IMAX made up the news tier.
